text:
zoe: quick flag from canary: new model 'mistral-liteq' (int8) producing intermittent 'trailing-data' JSON errors on toolcall suite — parse rate up from 0.5% -> 4.6% at 16:40 UTC.
kai: slice + config?
zoe: bench ran 4k-toolcall slice (slice-2026-03-30-c). config: model=mistral-liteq, quant=int8, batch=8, kv_cache=on, stream=on.
bench-ci: summary:
``njob: bc-1799
samples: 4000
parse_failure_rate: 0.046
common_err: JSONParseError(trailing-data / duplicated-blob)
``nmarc: can we get a sanitized example?
zoe: pasted small snippet (redacted):
{"action":"call","name":"get_profile","arguments":{"id":"u42"}}}{"action":"call","name":"get_profile","arguments":{"id":"u43"}}
kai: extra brace then another object. suggests duplicate suffix emitted at stream stitch or kv_cache replay. Did we change kernels recently?
zoe: recent push included int8 quant profile + attention-kernel v3. int16 run earlier had 0.8% failure.
marc: triage plan: 1) run kv_cache=false 2) run int16+v3 to isolate quant vs kernel 3) add a lightweight SDK repair: on parse fail try trimming after last '}' up to 128 chars and reparse; tag repaired with header x-json-repaired.
bench-ci: queued bc-1800: kv_cache=false, limit=1000.
repair-bot: auto-note: canary parse_failure > 3%  routing hold applied for mistral-liteq-int8.
bench-ci: bc-1800 interim: parse_failure -> 0.012 after 1k. kv_cache appears causal.
kai: good signal. marc: can you land runtime gating to block kv_cache for int8 models?
marc: yes, plan: if model.quant=="int8" then kv_cache_enabled=false by default; add metric kv_cache_blocked.
zoe: i'll deploy SDK repair to canary only and run full 4k with repairs+kv_cache_off. bench-ci queueing bc-1801.
bench-ci: bc-1801 completed: repaired_success_rate=0.051; overall parse_fail down to 0.009; false_repair_est=0.001 on gold subset. logs: https://bench.internal/runs/bc-1801/logs
kai: owners: marc -> runtime gating + metrics, zoe -> SDK repair + telemetry header, bench-ci -> reruns and dashboard, all -> add failing samples to s3://eng-ml/goldens/mistral-liteq/.
marc: note: need follow-ups: reproduce matrix streaming true/false x batch sizes to find fragility, collect token logits for failing traces, coordinate with model team about quant-token drift.
zoe: summary: root cause likely kv_cache replay interacting with int8 quantization causing duplicate-suffix/brace emissions. mitigation: block promotion, gate kv_cache for int8, ship soft repair, gather goldens. will keep routing hold 24h and monitor.
kai: thanks, please post any minimal failing examples to the goldens bucket.
zoe: closing thread after 24h stable.
